title: Create a new task
description: As a user, I want to create a task with a title and optional description so that work can be tracked.
acceptanceCriteria: A task can be created with a nonblank title and optional description.
The API generates a unique task ID and persists the task.
A successful create returns HTTP 201 and a Location header for the task.
A blank or missing title is rejected with HTTP 400 and useful validation details.
A created task can be retrieved with GET /tasks/{id}.

knownConstraints: title is required and must not be blank
H2 is disposable in local tests
